name: GeoBuddy
author: BuddyDevelopers

sections.description:
GeoBuddy is the foundation plugin for every GeoDirectory-powered directory site.

One free plugin gives you a stepwise form, a floating action bar, one-click demo sites, and — for the first time — an AI agent that can manage your directory for you. Everything else clips on as an addon.

At a Glance

  • 🤖 AI Management — Let Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP client read and manage your listings
  • 📋 Multistep Form — Stepwise “Add Listing” form, free, no addon needed
  • 🎯 Floating Action Bar — Sticky call-to-action bar on listing pages
  • 🗂️ One-Click Templates — Full demo sites imported in a few clicks
  • 🧩 Custom Fields — Social profile links + 360° virtual tour
  • 💡 Field Tooltips — Add rich informational tooltips to listing form fields
  • 🖼️ Admin Media Library — Select existing Media Library images for GeoDirectory listings
  • 👤 Add Listing Signup — Send guests through UsersWP registration, then back to the Add Listing form
  • 🧱 8+ Addons — Extend forms, messaging, weather, broadcasting & more

🤖 GeoBuddy AI — Run Your Directory With AI

This is the headline feature. GeoBuddy ships an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server built into WordPress’s Abilities API, so AI assistants can talk to your GeoDirectory site directly — no custom code, no Zapier, no manual admin work.

Free, built into GeoBuddy core — read-only:

  • List, get & search GeoDirectory listings
  • Browse categories, tags, custom fields & post types
  • Read GeoDirectory settings, countries & map markers
  • Read general WordPress site info, plugins & options

GeoBuddy AI addon — read/write control:

  • ✏️ Create & update listings
  • ⭐ Manage reviews
  • ⚙️ Manage GeoDirectory settings
  • 🔐 Scoped, auditable actions — nothing is silently deleted

How it connects: AI Client (Claude / ChatGPT / etc.) talks to the MCP Server in GeoBuddy core, which routes to the free Read tools and, if installed, the GeoBuddy AI addon’s Write tools — both acting on your GeoDirectory site.

GeoBuddy AI addon

Core Features (Free)

📋 Multistep Form — Breaks the GeoDirectory “Add Listing” form into clean steps with a progress indicator, works out of the box. Custom labels & progress bar styles are in the Multistep Form addon.

🎯 Floating Action Bar — Sticky bottom bar on listing detail pages with Call, WhatsApp, Share & Favorite (4 items, free). Unlimited items & full builder controls are in the Floating Action Bar addon.

🗂️ Site Templates — One-click importer for full GeoDirectory demo sites: theme, plugins, pages, categories, listings & menus in one guided flow. Additive (safe) or Full Reset (replaces everything) modes. Free templates are open to everyone; paid templates need a GeoBuddy Bundle license.

🧩 Custom Fields — Adds a few extra listing fields: social links (YouTube, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, TikTok) and a 360° virtual tour embed.

💡 Field Tooltips — Add optional rich-text information tooltips beside GeoDirectory fields on add/edit listing forms. Customize the tooltips icon hover, background, text, and border colors from GeoBuddy settings.

🖼️ Admin Media Library — Optionally select existing WordPress Media Library images while editing GeoDirectory listings in wp-admin, alongside GeoDirectory’s default uploader. Frontend add/edit listing forms are not affected.

👤 Add Listing Signup — Optionally redirect logged-out visitors from the GeoDirectory Add Listing page to UsersWP registration, then return them to the Add Listing form after signup, email activation, and login. Enable it under GeoBuddy settings → User Flow. Requires UsersWP.

Addons

  • 🤖 GeoBuddy AI — full read/write AI management of your site
  • 📋 Multistep Form — custom step labels, progress bar styles & positions
  • 🎯 Floating Action Bar — unlimited action items + full builder controls
  • 💬 Private Message — direct messaging between users & listing owners
  • 🎉 Confetti — celebration animation on listing submission
  • 📢 Announcement Bar — site-wide announcement banner
  • ⛅ Weather Forecast — real-time weather on listing pages
  • 📡 Broadcasting — broadcast messages to users or listing owners

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.5+ (6.9+ for the AI/MCP server)
  • PHP 7.4+
  • GeoDirectory plugin (required)
  • UsersWP plugin (optional, for Add Listing Signup)

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
See: http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
sections.installation:
1. Upload the geobuddy folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
  2. Activate GeoBuddy
  3. Make sure GeoDirectory is installed and activated
  4. Configure everything from the GeoBuddy settings panel
sections.faq:
Does GeoBuddy work without GeoDirectory?

No, GeoDirectory is required.

What does GeoBuddy AI actually do?

It exposes your GeoDirectory data through an MCP server so AI assistants can query it. Core GeoBuddy is read-only and free; the GeoBuddy AI addon unlocks write access (create/update listings, manage reviews & settings).

How do I connect claude.ai or ChatGPT?

Go to GeoBuddy → AI → Connected Apps and copy the Connector URL. In claude.ai, open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector. In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps & Connectors → Create and choose OAuth. Paste the URL, then log in to your WordPress site and click Approve. Your site must be live on HTTPS.

Administrators can always approve connections. To let other roles connect, tick them on the AI → Access tab. You can disconnect an app at any time from the Connected Apps tab. Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other tools that use the API key keep working as before.

claude.ai or ChatGPT says “Authorization failed”. What do I do?

Open GeoBuddy → AI → Connected Apps and click Run Check. The most common cause is a host that strips the Authorization header before WordPress sees it. If the check reports that, ask your host to add one of these lines:

  • Apache or LiteSpeed (.htaccess, above the WordPress block): CGIPassAuth On or SetEnvIf Authorization "(.*)" HTTP_AUTHORIZATION=$1
  • nginx + PHP-FPM: fastcgi_param HTTP_AUTHORIZATION $http_authorization;

Also make sure no security plugin or firewall blocks the REST API (/wp-json/).

Do I need a license for templates?

Free templates are open to everyone. Paid templates require a GeoBuddy Bundle Membership license, entered in the Templates tab.

Will importing a template overwrite my site?

Only in Full Reset mode. Additive mode (default) adds content alongside what you already have. Full Reset cannot be undone — back up first.
sections.changelog:
2.1.1

  • Fixed the geobuddy-gd-get-listing & geobuddy-gd-get-fields tools issue with custom fields.

2.1.0

  • Added: Connect claude.ai and ChatGPT custom connectors through OAuth 2.1. Log in to WordPress, click Approve, and the MCP tools appear. No API key needed.
  • Added: AI → Connected Apps tab with the connector URL, a server check (HTTPS, Authorization header, discovery URLs) and a list of connected apps you can revoke.
  • Added: AI → Access tab to choose which roles may connect AI apps (new geobuddy_use_mcp capability; administrators always have it).
  • Added: Daily cleanup of expired sign-ins and unused connected apps.
  • Changed: ChatGPT setup instructions now use OAuth instead of a custom API-key header.
  • The API key (X-MCP-Key) keeps working as before for Claude Code, Claude Desktop and other tools.
  • Fixed the media display issue when displaying through the Offloading

2.0.3

  • Added the setting to sync the Geodirectory images to the WordPress media library with DB post table as a attachment
  • Fixed the Image upload issue when allowed type setting is configured in GeoDirectory file upload fields
  • Changed the footer All Products URL with the correct URL

2.0.2

  • Added Add Listing Signup user flow — redirect guests to UsersWP registration and return them to the Add Listing form after signup
  • Fixed plugin checker issues in field tooltips and admin media library upload
  • Fixed variable naming issue in the General settings tab
  • Bumped Tested up to: 7.1

2.0.1

  • Added configurable tooltips to GeoDirectory add/edit listing form fields
  • Added an admin-only Media Library picker alongside GeoDirectory’s default listing image uploader
  • Fixed the theme compatibility issue
  • Fixed the claude installer issue
  • Fixed the bundle member ship link on the admin side inside the template tab

2.0.0

  • Added GeoBuddy AI — built-in MCP server for read-only AI access to GeoDirectory data, with the GeoBuddy AI addon unlocking write access
  • Rewrote readme with addon links, screenshots, and updated tags
  • Renamed Floating Bar Pro addon to Floating Action Bar

1.0.9

  • Added built-in basic multistep form with stepwise design (free, no addon required)
  • Fixed multistep form frontend step navigation issue
  • Fixed Join Community link URL
  • Fixed plugin checker compatibility issues

1.0.8

  • 360° virtual tour link now opens inside an iframe overlay instead of a plain link
  • Add multistep form free options with stepwise design

1.0.7

  • Fixed WordPress Coding Standards lint errors across plugin (translators comments, file access guards, deprecated functions)
  • Replaced unlink()/rmdir() with WP Filesystem equivalents
  • Removed debug error_log() calls from template import classes
  • Replaced deprecated get_page_by_title() with get_posts()
  • Bumped Tested up to: 7.0

1.0.6

  • Updated readme with Site Templates / demo importer documentation
  • Removed outdated “Coming Soon” notice from welcome screen

1.0.5

  • Added Site Templates tab — browse and import pre-built GeoDirectory site templates
  • Added GeoDirectory native data import (categories, listings, reviews, settings)
  • Added GeoBuddy Bundle Membership license activation for paid templates
  • Fixed block theme filtering not working in backend template selection
  • Fixed image handling on template reimport
  • Fixed duplicate nav menus created during WXR import
  • Fixed GeoDirectory CPT posts cleanup on full reset import
  • Added link to GeoBuddy Bundle Membership page in templates description

1.0.4

  • Improved compatibility with latest WordPress version
  • Minor performance improvements
  • UI refinements

1.0.3

  • Enhanced social media field validation
  • Bug fixes

1.0.0

  • Initial release
